# CommonMark spec examples

`spec.txt` is an unchanged copy of the
[CommonMark Spec](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/), version 0.31.2, from
[commonmark/commonmark-spec](https://github.com/commonmark/commonmark-spec) at
tag `0.31.2` (commit `9103e341a973013013bb1a80e13567007c5cef6f`).

The CommonMark Spec is Copyright (C) 2014-16 John MacFarlane, and is licensed
under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

To fetch the copy again, run this from the repository root:

```sh
curl -fsSL -o internal/markdown/testdata/commonmark/spec.txt \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/commonmark/commonmark-spec/0.31.2/spec.txt
```
